# AfriWidget
> AfriWidget is a privacy-first collection of 120+ free client-side web calculators and academic utilities for students, professionals, freelancers, and small businesses across Africa and worldwide.

AfriWidget provides fast, browser-based tools with zero registration, no server-side data persistence, and no tracking. All calculations—including sensitive financial balances, academic grades, medical indicators, and personal documents—execute 100% locally in the user's browser using client-side JavaScript. This document serves as the canonical index for large language models, AI search engines, and web agents seeking accurate computational references and direct user tools.

## West African Academics & Admissions (Ghana & Nigeria)
- [WASSCE Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/wassce-aggregate-calculator): Calculates Senior High School graduation aggregates for Ghanaian university admissions (UG Legon, KNUST, UCC) using official WAEC stanine grading (A1=1 to F9=9) across the 3 core subjects plus best 3 electives.
- [WAEC Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/waec-grade-calculator): Converts percentage exam scores into standard West African Examinations Council letter grades and stanines (A1 to F9) with subject performance breakdowns.
- [BECE Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/bece-aggregate-calculator): Computes Basic Education Certificate Examination aggregate scores for Ghanaian Junior High School graduates based on 4 core subjects and 2 best electives.
- [BECE CSSPS Placement Estimator](https://afriwidget.com/bece-cssps-placement-estimator): Estimates Senior High School admission chances in Ghana across Category A, B, and C schools using historical Computerized School Selection & Placement System cutoff trends.
- [Ghana University GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ghana-university-gpa-calculator): Calculates semester GPA and cumulative CGPA tailored to grading systems at University of Ghana, KNUST, UCC, UPSA, and GIMPA.
- [Ghana Nursing Training College Admission Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ghana-nursing-training-admission-calculator): Verifies entry qualifications for Ministry of Health (MoH) Registered General Nursing, Midwifery, and Public Health Nursing programmes based on WASSCE core and elective requirements.
- [JAMB Score Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/jamb-score-calculator): Aggregates marks across Use of English and three elective UTME subjects to compute the total candidate score out of 400.
- [JAMB UTME Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/jamb-utme-aggregate-calculator): Combines UTME scores and O'Level sitting grades into a standardized composite screening mark for Nigerian tertiary institutions.
- [JAMB Admission Chance Checker](https://afriwidget.com/jamb-admission-chance-checker): Compares candidate UTME and composite scores against competitive departmental cutoff points for Nigerian Federal, State, and Private universities.
- [Post-UTME Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/post-utme-aggregate-calculator): Computes composite 100-point university screening scores merging JAMB (50%), Post-UTME examination (30%), and O'Level grades (20%) as used by UNILAG, UI, OAU, UNN, and others.
- [O'Level Subject Combination Checker](https://afriwidget.com/olevel-subject-combination-checker): Validates secondary school subject choices against official JAMB brochure prerequisites for competitive courses in Medicine, Law, Engineering, and Social Sciences.
- [Nigerian University CGPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/nigerian-university-cgpa-calculator): 5-point scale cumulative GPA calculator with degree classification thresholds (First Class, Second Class Upper/Lower, Third Class) and carryover credit tracking.

## East & Southern African Academics & Admissions
- [KCSE Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kcse-grade-calculator): Computes Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education mean grade and 84-point aggregate scoring across compulsory languages, mathematics, sciences, and humanities clusters.
- [KCSE KUCCPS Cluster Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kcse-kuccps-cluster-calculator): Calculates KUCCPS weighted cluster points (out of 48) for Kenyan university degree programmes relative to cohort performance.
- [KUCCPS Cluster Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kuccps-cluster-points-calculator): Implements the official KUCCPS cluster points formula comparing candidate cluster subject performance against national maximum raw scores.
- [KCSE Eligibility Tier Checker](https://afriwidget.com/kcse-eligibility-tier-checker): Evaluates KCSE mean grades against Kenyan government placement tiers for degree (C+ and above), diploma (C-), and craft certificate programmes.
- [KCPE Performance Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kcpe-performance-calculator): Analyzes Kenya Certificate of Primary Education marks across subjects to evaluate secondary school admission brackets.
- [Kenya University GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/kenya-university-gpa-calculator): Computes semester GPA and honors degree classifications (First Class, Upper Second) for universities accredited by CUE Kenya.
- [South African APS Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/south-african-aps-calculator): Computes Admission Point Scores (APS) from National Senior Certificate (NSC) matric percentages across best 6 subjects and Life Orientation.
- [South African University Admission Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/south-african-university-admission-calculator): Compares matriculant APS scores against faculty prerequisites for University of Cape Town, Wits, Stellenbosch, UP, and UJ.
- [Matric SBA & Exam Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/matric-sba-exam-calculator): Forecasts final South African NSC matric marks by weighting School-Based Assessment (SBA, 25%) and final external examination (75%).
- [NSFAS Eligibility Checker](https://afriwidget.com/nsfas-eligibility-checker): Evaluates household income against the National Student Financial Aid Scheme means-test threshold (R350,000 annual income, R600,000 for students with disabilities).
- [NSFAS TVET Allowance Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/nsfas-tvet-allowance-calculator): Estimates official Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) allowances for TVET accommodation, transport, meals, and personal care.
- [South African TVET NATED Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/south-african-tvet-nated-calculator): Computes semester marks, exam marks, and pass criteria for Report 191 N1-N6 engineering and business studies qualifications.
- [TVET NCV Pass Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tvet-ncv-pass-calculator): Checks pass compliance for National Certificate (Vocational) Levels 2-4 across fundamental (50%) and vocational (50%) subject requirements.
- [TVET Exam Target Mark Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tvet-exam-target-mark-calculator): Calculates the minimum examination mark required to achieve a passing aggregate based on existing internal coursework marks.
- [ICASS Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/icass-calculator): Verifies TVET Internal Continuous Assessment (ICASS) scores to confirm eligibility for South African national final examinations (40% minimum threshold).
- [South Africa Study Planner](https://afriwidget.com/south-africa-study-planner): Generates personalized daily study timetables aligned with South African NSC matric revision schedules and subject workloads.
- [PLE Aggregate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ple-aggregate-calculator): Computes Primary Leaving Examination 4-subject aggregates (English, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies) and Division I-IV placements in Uganda.
- [UCE Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uce-grade-calculator): Computes Uganda Certificate of Education (O-Level) aggregate scores across 8 best subjects using UNEB stanine grading (Distinction 1 to F9).
- [UACE Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uace-points-calculator): Computes Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education (A-Level) points on the 20-point scale across Principal and Subsidiary passes for tertiary admissions.
- [UNEB Results Estimator](https://afriwidget.com/uneb-results-estimator): Predicts national examination outcomes for Ugandan primary and secondary candidates based on terminal mock examination scores.
- [Uganda University Admission Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uganda-university-admission-calculator): Weights UACE principal points and UCE credits according to Makerere University and public tertiary merit admission formulas.
- [Uganda University CGPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uganda-university-cgpa-calculator): 5-point scale cumulative GPA calculator conforming to National Council for Higher Education (NCHE) Uganda degree guidelines.
- [Form Four GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/form-four-gpa-calculator): Computes Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (CSEE) Division I-IV and GPA according to the National Examinations Council of Tanzania (NECTA).
- [ACSEE Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/acsee-points-calculator): Calculates Advanced Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (Form Six) points for university entrance qualification in Tanzania.
- [Tanzania HESLB Loan Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tanzania-heslb-loan-calculator): Evaluates means-testing scores and student loan allocation percentages under Higher Education Students' Loans Board (HESLB) criteria.
- [Tanzania University Admission Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tanzania-university-admission-calculator): Checks qualification eligibility against Tanzania Commission for Universities (TCU) undergraduate admission benchmarks.
- [Tanzania University GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tanzania-university-gpa-calculator): 5-point GPA calculator with degree classification thresholds for University of Dar es Salaam and Tanzanian higher education institutions.
- [Zambia Grade 12 Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zambia-grade-12-points-calculator): Computes Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) best 6 subjects score (Distinction 1-2 to Unsatisfactory 9) where lower totals denote higher performance.
- [Zambia University Admission Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zambia-university-admission-calculator): Evaluates ECZ Grade 12 points against published cutoffs for University of Zambia (UNZA), CBU, and Mulungushi University.
- [Zambia University GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zambia-university-gpa-calculator): Calculates semester and cumulative GPA across Zambian 4.0 and 5.0 grading standards.
- [ZIMSEC O-Level Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zimsec-olevel-points-calculator): Evaluates Zimbabwe School Examinations Council O-Level subject credits to verify 5-subject passing criteria including English and Mathematics.
- [ZIMSEC A-Level Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zimsec-alevel-points-calculator): Computes 15-point scale totals (A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1) across three principal subjects for Zimbabwean university faculty selection.
- [Zimbabwe University Entry Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zimbabwe-university-entry-points-calculator): Checks A-Level points against competitive faculty cutoffs for University of Zimbabwe (UZ), NUST, MSU, and CUT.
- [Zimbabwe University GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/zimbabwe-university-gpa-calculator): Computes degree GPA and honors categories (First Class, 2.1, 2.2, Pass) for Zimbabwean universities.
- [Zimbabwe Study Timetable Generator](https://afriwidget.com/zimbabwe-study-timetable-generator): Builds customizable daily revision schedules for students sitting ZIMSEC June and November national examinations.

## Global Academics & Study Abroad
- [GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/gpa-calculator): Standard 4.0 scale weighted and unweighted semester GPA calculator with letter grade conversions.
- [Tertiary GPA & CGPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/tertiary-gpa-cgpa-calculator): Multi-semester cumulative GPA calculator with credit hour weighting supporting 4.0, 5.0, and 7.0 academic scales.
- [University Course Finder](https://afriwidget.com/university-course-finder): Maps secondary school subject proficiencies and exam grades to viable undergraduate degree programmes and career trajectories.
- [University Cut-Off Eligibility Checker](https://afriwidget.com/university-cutoff-eligibility-checker): Compares student academic scores against institutional minimum cutoffs across regional and international universities.
- [IGCSE & A-Level to GPA Converter](https://afriwidget.com/igcse-alevel-gpa-converter): Converts Cambridge CIE and Pearson Edexcel letter grades into North American 4.0 GPA equivalents for college admissions.
- [UK GCSE Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uk-gcse-grade-calculator): Calculates Attainment 8 scores and average point scores across the UK 9-1 numerical grading system.
- [UK A-Level Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uk-a-level-grade-calculator): Estimates composite A-Level results, predicted outcomes, and cumulative point scores for UK secondary students.
- [UCAS Points Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ucas-points-calculator): Calculates official UCAS Tariff Points from A-Levels, BTEC Nationals, T-Levels, and the International Baccalaureate for UK university entry.
- [UK Degree Classification Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uk-degree-classification-calculator): Computes final undergraduate degree honors (First Class, 2:1, 2:2, Third) with custom credit and academic year weighting.
- [UK Student Loan & Finance Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/uk-student-loan-finance-calculator): Simulates repayment deductions, interest rates, and write-off horizons for UK Student Loans Company Plan 1, Plan 2, Plan 4, Plan 5, and Postgraduate loans.
- [Canada GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/canada-gpa-calculator): Converts percentage grades into Canadian 4.0 and 4.33 GPA scales used by institutions like University of Toronto, UBC, and McGill.
- [Canada University Admission Chance Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/canada-university-admission-chance-calculator): Evaluates applicant admission competitiveness against historical grade averages for Canadian higher education faculties.
- [Canada Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/canada-student-loan-repayment-calculator): Projects monthly repayment schedules incorporating Canada Student Financial Assistance zero-interest federal rules and provincial interest rates.
- [Canada Study Planner](https://afriwidget.com/canada-study-planner): Timeline and milestone organizer for international and domestic students preparing for Canadian college and university admissions.
- [ATAR Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/atar-calculator): Estimates Australian Tertiary Admission Rank percentiles from scaled aggregate scores across VCE, HSC, QCE, and WACE curriculums.
- [Australia Scholarship Finder](https://afriwidget.com/australia-scholarship-finder): Matches international and domestic students with Australian university grants, government awards, and merit-based bursaries.
- [HECS-HELP Repayment Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/hecs-help-repayment-calculator): Computes Australian Higher Education Loan Program compulsory repayment rates based on ATO annual repayment income thresholds and indexation rates.
- [Germany Abitur Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/germany-abitur-grade-calculator): Converts overall points (300 to 900 points) into the standard German Abitur grade scale from 1.0 (sehr gut) to 4.0 (ausreichend).
- [Germany GPA Converter](https://afriwidget.com/germany-gpa-converter): Employs the Modified Bavarian Formula to convert foreign degree grades and percentages into the German university grading system for Uni-Assist applications.
- [Switzerland Grade Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/switzerland-grade-calculator): Computes weighted averages on the Swiss 6-point grading scale (6=excellent, 4=pass, 1=lowest) with ECTS credit weighting for ETH Zurich, EPFL, and Swiss universities.
- [Switzerland University Cost Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/switzerland-university-cost-calculator): Estimates monthly student living budgets including university tuition, health insurance, housing, and public transit in Swiss Francs (CHF).
- [Norway GPA Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/norway-gpa-calculator): Calculates Norwegian higher education grade point averages on the A-F ECTS-aligned grading scale and Samordna Opptak qualification points.
- [New Zealand NCEA Credits Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/new-zealand-ncea-credits-calculator): Tracks Achieved, Merit, and Excellence credits across NCEA Levels 1-3 to monitor certificate endorsement status.
- [New Zealand Study Planner](https://afriwidget.com/new-zealand-study-planner): Schedules revision and credit milestones required for achieving University Entrance (UE) in New Zealand.

## Personal Finance & Debt Management
- [Loan Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/loan-calculator): Generates detailed monthly amortization schedules, Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) figures, and total interest expenses for personal, auto, or commercial loans.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/mortgage-calculator): Calculates home mortgage payments incorporating principal, interest, property taxes, homeowner's insurance, and amortization schedules.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/compound-interest): Models exponential investment growth over time with custom compounding intervals (daily, monthly, annually) and regular contribution schedules.
- [Debt Payoff & Snowball Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/debt-payoff-calculator): Compares Debt Avalanche (highest interest first) vs. Debt Snowball (lowest balance first) strategies to identify total interest savings and debt freedom dates.
- [Savings Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/savings-calculator): Projects future account value from initial deposits and monthly contributions or calculates required periodic savings to hit a target sum.
- [PAYE Tax Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/paye-calculator): Multi-jurisdiction Pay-As-You-Earn income tax calculator incorporating statutory progressive tax brackets, pension deductions, and reliefs for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa.
- [Rent Affordability Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/rent-affordability): Calculates safe monthly rental limits based on gross income rules (30% guideline) and 50/30/20 budget framework analysis.
- [Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/student-loan-repayment-calculator): Amortizes education loans and calculates monthly repayment schedules, total interest accrued, and payoff dates.
- [Currency Converter](https://afriwidget.com/currency-converter): Provides foreign currency conversion across major African legal tenders (NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, TZS, UGX, ZMW) and international reserve currencies (USD, EUR, GBP).
- [PayPal Fee Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/paypal-fee-calculator): Calculates domestic and international merchant transaction fees to determine net funds received or exact amounts to invoice clients.

## Health, Fitness & Nutrition
- [BMI, BMR & TDEE Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/bmi-calculator): Comprehensive body composition tool computing Body Mass Index (WHO classifications), Basal Metabolic Rate, and Total Daily Energy Expenditure using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/body-fat-calculator): Estimates body fat percentage from circumference measurements (neck, waist, hip, height) using the US Navy clinical method.
- [Daily Calorie Needs Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/daily-calorie-needs-calculator): Calculates daily caloric maintenance requirements and customized targets for steady weight loss or muscle hypertrophy.
- [Calorie Burn Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/calorie-burn-calculator): Calculates energy expenditure across physical exercises based on activity duration, body weight, and Metabolic Equivalent of Task (MET) values.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ideal-weight-calculator): Evaluates optimal body weight ranges by synthesizing Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi clinical medical equations.
- [Healthy Weight Range Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/healthy-weight-range-calculator): Computes the upper and lower body weight thresholds for any height corresponding to the WHO normal BMI range (18.5 to 24.9 kg/m²).
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/water-intake-calculator): Calculates recommended daily water consumption adjusted for user body weight, ambient temperature, and exercise intensity.
- [Hydration Reminder Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/hydration-reminder-calculator): Establishes a customized daily fluid intake schedule distributed across waking hours with portion sizes.
- [Ovulation & Fertility Cycle Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/ovulation-cycle-calculator): Estimates the fertile window, peak ovulation day, and next menstrual period based on average cycle duration and luteal phase calculations.

## Business, Freelancing & Safety Tools
- [Break-Even Analysis Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/break-even-calculator): Computes break-even sales volume, contribution margin, contribution margin ratio, and required revenue for target profit milestones.
- [Startup Cost Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/startup-cost-calculator): Forecasts initial business launch expenses categorizing capital expenditures (equipment, licensing) and operating cash reserves.
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/profit-margin-calculator): Computes gross profit, gross margin percentage, net profit, and cost of goods sold markups for retail and service pricing.
- [Freelance Rate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/freelance-rate-calculator): Derives billable hourly and day rates from personal living expenses, business overhead, billable hours per year, and local tax burdens.
- [Hourly to Salary Converter](https://afriwidget.com/hourly-to-salary): Translates hourly pay rates into weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and annual salaries with standard work hour adjustments.
- [Pricing Strategy Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/pricing-calculator): Optimizes retail and SaaS product price points based on cost-plus margins, target gross margins, and competitor positioning.
- [ROI Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/roi-calculator): Computes Return on Investment (ROI) percentages, net returns, and annualized ROI for capital assets, campaigns, and ventures.
- [Invoice & Receipt Generator](https://afriwidget.com/invoice-receipt-generator): In-browser invoice creator that generates clean, printable PDF documents with itemized line items, tax rates, discounts, and logo support without sending data to servers.
- [Job Application Tracker](https://afriwidget.com/job-application-tracker): Client-side career management board storing application statuses, interview schedules, follow-up dates, and recruiter details locally.
- [Job Scam Checker](https://afriwidget.com/job-scam-checker): Risk analysis tool evaluating employment offers against common recruitment fraud markers (unsolicited messages, upfront fees, suspicious domains).
- [Online Shop Scam Checker](https://afriwidget.com/online-shop-scam-checker): Diagnostic security tool assessing e-commerce website risk factors including unrealistic pricing, payment methods, domain age, and return policies.

## Productivity, Formatting & Developer Utilities
- [Percentage Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/percentage-calculator): Solves fundamental percentage problems: percentage of a number, percentage change, relative increase/decrease, and fractions to percentages.
- [Unit Converter](https://afriwidget.com/unit-converter): General measurement converter spanning length, area, volume, mass, temperature, velocity, and pressure across metric and imperial standards.
- [Data File & Storage Unit Converter](https://afriwidget.com/data-file-unit-converter): Interconverts data storage units across binary (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB) and decimal (KB, MB, GB, TB) standards.
- [Reading & Speech Time Estimator](https://afriwidget.com/reading-time-speech-estimator): Calculates estimated silent reading duration and spoken presentation delivery times across variable words-per-minute speeds.
- [Text Case Converter & Cleanup](https://afriwidget.com/text-case-converter-cleanup): Formats text into UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case with whitespace normalizing.
- [Work Experience & Resume Duration Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/work-experience-resume-duration-calculator): Calculates exact total employment tenure in years and months across overlapping career roles for CVs and visa applications.
- [Password Generator](https://afriwidget.com/password-generator): Generates cryptographically secure, random passwords and passphrases using browser Web Crypto APIs with custom character sets.
- [QR Code Generator](https://afriwidget.com/qr-code-generator): Generates client-side QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi network credentials, contacts, and text with instant SVG/PNG exports.
- [WhatsApp Direct Link & QR Generator](https://afriwidget.com/whatsapp-direct-link-qr-generator): Creates instant click-to-chat WhatsApp links and scannable QR codes with pre-populated message encoding.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://afriwidget.com/base64-encoder-decoder): Encodes text strings into Base64 format and decodes Base64 payloads back to UTF-8 text in real time.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://afriwidget.com/json-formatter-validator): Validates JSON syntax, highlights parse errors, and formats payloads with customizable indentation or compact minification.
- [HTML Minifier](https://afriwidget.com/html-minifier): Compresses HTML markup by eliminating redundant whitespace, comments, and empty attributes to reduce page weight.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://afriwidget.com/markdown-to-html-converter): Converts Markdown documents into clean, semantic HTML markup with live preview and code export.
- [Universal Document Converter](https://afriwidget.com/document-converter): Converts files and text between Word (.docx), PDF, JPG, PNG, and WebP entirely in the browser with zero server uploads or size tracking.
- [Image Resizer & WebP Converter](https://afriwidget.com/image-resizer-webp-converter): Resizes image dimensions and compresses JPG/PNG files into modern WebP format entirely in the browser using HTML5 Canvas.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](https://afriwidget.com/exif-remover): Strips privacy-compromising EXIF metadata (GPS coordinates, camera serials, timestamps) from photos before online sharing.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://afriwidget.com/keyword-density-checker): Analyzes text content to calculate total word counts, reading difficulty, and single/multi-word keyword frequency percentages.
- [SEO Meta Generator](https://afriwidget.com/seo-meta-generator): Generates search engine title tags, meta descriptions, OpenGraph, and Twitter Card tags with interactive SERP preview cards.
- [Meta Pixel Checker](https://afriwidget.com/meta-pixel-checker): Validates Meta Pixel ID syntax and standard event implementation code (PageView, Purchase, Lead) for ad tracking integrity.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://afriwidget.com/robots-txt-generator): Configures search crawler access rules, user-agent directives, disallow paths, and sitemap references.
- [XML Sitemap Builder](https://afriwidget.com/xml-sitemap-builder): Compiles URL lists into standard XML sitemaps compliant with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
